searchText: Option 4 would be CL filling the gaps of `engine_getBlobsBundle` response assuming that gaps occurred due to reorgs, therefore, CL has required data in its storage Hi, got a question about https://github.com/ethereum/consensus-specs/blob/dev/specs/eip4844/p2p-interface.md#blobssidecarsbyrange-v1 It says `Peers that are unable to reply to blobs sidecars requests within the MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOBS_SIDECARS_REQUESTS epoch range SHOULD respond with error code 3: ResourceUnavailable.` So, on every request it should be checked that all sidecars within the `MIN_EPOCHS_FOR_BLOBS_SIDECARS_REQUESTS` range are available, regardless of what range is actually requested? **4844 call in 30m**: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/686 <adietrichs> > <adietrichs> Can’t make the call today, but have started to look into specific (simple) mempool dos protection recommendations. If I remember correctly, there was a desire to have those in the EIP once ready. (re @sharded_data_bot: <timbeiko> **4844 call in 30m**: https://github.com/ethereum/pm/issues/686) <gakonst> Can't make it either but bench is ready to run, EF devops is prepared as well, so we'll run tomorrow. Got everything set up and the goerli eth for it thanks for the update, guys!
